full_judgment: 3. Defendant Nos. 1 and 8 contested the suit by filing a joint written statement denying material allegations and stating that the suit property originally belonged to their predecessor Alabuddin who took lease of the same from the landlord on tile basis of kabuliyat and patta from the landlord Gouri Pria Debi at an annual jama of Taka 16.00 and as the taluk of Gouripria Debi was purchased by Nabin Chandra Chakraborty said Alabuddin executed a kabuliyat in favour of the purchaser landlord who also executed a paua in his favour on 24th Kartick, 1310 BS Ext. 'A'. Since then Alabuddin was in possession of the entire suit property. Further case of the defendants was that the said Alabuddin had a brother named Sona Guzi who married mother of plaintiffs predecessor Rahmat Ali who came to the house of Sona Gazi and after the death of Sonagazi and his 2nd wife out of compassion Alabuddin allowed Rahmat Ali to possess the Suit plot Nos.160, 224 and 226. Taking advantage of old age and ignorance of Alabuddin the said Rahmat Ali during the CS operation wrongly recorded 0.08 annas share of the suit land in the suit khatian though he had no title in the suit property. Further case of the contesting defendants is that Yusuf Ali and Jinnat Ali, two sons of Alabuddin while in title and possession of the suit land executed a confirmatory kabuliyat in favour of landlord, Nabin Chakraborty on 4th Agrahayan 1331 BS and got a paua on the same date from the said landlord Ext. A(1) and since then they are in possession of the entire suit land except those three suit plots on payment of rents from before CS khatian in the name of Alabuddin and his heirs vide Ext. 'B' series. Their further case is that sons of Rahmat Ali relinquished possession of plot Nos. 224 and 226 in favour of Ishab Ali and Jinnat Ali after taking settlement of some land from them by a kabuliyat dated 3rd Chaitra, 1330 BS Ext. C. Their further case is that Alabuddin and after his death his heirs paid rent of the suit property to the landlord.
